title: POP Dimension
summary: Official Derivative page for POP dimension metadata, covering rows/columns/slices, TOP and POP conversion shape preservation, built-in dimension attributes, and Python access through OP.dimension.
guidance: Use this article when a POP plan depends on preserving or interpreting point-list structure across generators, TOP conversions, lookups, or GLSL indexing.
Dimension is metadata passed from POP to POP and describes point organization such as columns, rows, slices, or more general N-dimensional layouts.
When converting POP to TOP or TOP to POP, preserve dimension so the output width, height, and point arrangement match the source structure.
All POPs have at least one dimension; the product of all dimension sizes should equal the POP point count.
Use built-in dimension attributes such as _NumDim, _DimSize, _DimI, _DimU, and _DimCy when lookup or shader logic needs structured coordinates.
In Python, OP.dimension is the list of dimension sizes and len(OP.dimension) is the number of dimensions.
